verses.t: “Sattimāni, bhikkhave, saṁyojanāni. Katamāni satta? Anunayasaṁyojanaṁ, paṭighasaṁyojanaṁ, diṭṭhisaṁyojanaṁ, vicikicchāsaṁyojanaṁ, mānasaṁyojanaṁ, issāsaṁyojanaṁ, macchariyasaṁyojanaṁ. Imāni kho, bhikkhave, satta saṁyojanānī”ti. Dasamaṁ. Dhanavaggo paṭhamo.
Dve piyāni balaṁ dhanaṁ, Saṅkhittañceva vitthataṁ; Uggaṁ saṁyojanañceva, Pahānaṁ macchariyena cāti.
